thread:
Noah Diaz: quick shoutout to Priya and Jared for the on-the-wire rescue earlier. Demo audience never saw the hiccup — massive relief. :relieved: :clap:

Priya Singh: thanks! Jared and I swapped rollbacks and toggled the canary, weird race in routing rules. ops-bot alert pointed us to the right cluster. :mag:

Jared Kim: putting a small note here: the routing rule mismatch happened when a stale deploy metadata lingered during a multi-region deploy. I pushed a short fix to the deploy tool to validate metadata before promoting. :hammer_and_wrench:

Noah Diaz: love it. Filing a follow-up RFC to make the validation more comprehensive, but wanted to give badges now. Virtual coffee for Priya/Jared coming your way. :coffee:

Ava Morales: real-life treat incoming: I dropped a box of brownie bites in the kitchen labeled "ops heroes". Grab one and sign the sticky so we can keep track. :brown_heart:

ops-bot: incident #2081: routing_anomaly detected. mitigated by canary rollback. Notified: Priya Singh, Jared Kim. :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: small doc update planned for the runbook so next on-call sees the exact steps. I'll ping eng-runbooks when it's live.

Jared Kim: happy to pair tomorrow morning for 15m to walk through the change. Also calling first dibs on a brownie. :raised_hands:

Noah Diaz: thanks team. Micro-hero shoutouts keep morale high. If anyone wants to add kudos here, drop a line and i'll make a tiny recognition note for the weekly email. :sparkles:
